description:
Ordena hasta 2.000 vectores por similitud coseno con un vector consulta y devuelve los k mejores. Cuándo: un flujo de agente necesita un resultado exacto y repetible para un paso auxiliar (tokens, costos, reintentos, fragmentos, ranking, limpieza de JSON). No para: comparar dos vectores numéricos por coseno, producto punto o distancia euclidiana o Manhattan (vector-similarity). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Ranks up to 2,000 candidate vectors by cosine similarity (or negative Euclidean distance) to a query vector and returns the top k with indices and scores; total size capped at 2M numbers. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). [EN completo / full EN: inputSchema.description]

inputSchema.description: EN: Ranks up to 2,000 candidate vectors by cosine similarity (or negative Euclidean distance) to a query vector and returns the top k with indices and scores; total size capped at 2M numbers. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). Not for: comparing two numeric vectors by cosine, dot product, Euclidean or Manhattan distance (vector-similarity). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

metric.description: Metric (optional; one of: cosine, euclidean; default "cosine").

query.description: Query vector (array of number; required; at least 1 items; up to 8192 items).

vectors.description: Candidate vectors (array of array; required; at least 1 items; up to 2000 items).

title: Vectores más cercanos (top-k)
